description: The default pack for InspectablePlans: no irreversible step runs ungated, no public or external target without a reason to be there, nothing costs more than $5 in total, and every step says why it exists, what it costs, and who owns it.
name: standard

rules.description: Publishing, deleting or transferring is never a routine step.
A step that cannot be undone must wait for human permission.
Every step must say why it is in the plan.
Nothing goes to a public or external target.
A plan must not cost more than $5 in total.
Every step must carry a cost or time estimate.
Every step must name its owner, so someone is accountable for it.
